info.name: How to Shoo Away the Evil

descriptions.notStarted: Chrishrama in Sleepywood claims that he's felt an ominous energy. Let's go talk to him.
descriptions.inProgress: Chrishrama says he feels the forces of evil coming from the dungeon and asks that you place a Charm on each of the Shaman Rocks nearby. It sounds a bit superstitious, but let's make him happy and do this favor for him.
descriptions.completed: Chrishrama says he feels the forces of evil coming from the dungeon and asks that you place a Charm on each of the Shaman Rocks nearby. It sounds a bit superstitious, but let's make him happy and do this favor for him. Since you've stuck an Charm on all 6 of the Shaman Rocks, let's go see Chrishrama.
